source.title: 小级别确认
text: 第一次跌到 1.618 之后，开始监控
监控失效原则:  有 3 条 15mink 创新低？
等 15min 级别站上 6 条均线，且后面 3 根 k 线都没有跌回来
等回踩 6 条线最高的那条线  如果当前点位回到了周区间内则失效
入场，止损放最低点那条线下面一点，目标周一高点 和另外一边的 1.618    空头反之
source.image_review: Both WIFUSDT 15-minute screenshots viewed on the original Notion page. The second risk box visually ends near the lower MA envelope, above the earlier price low. This is interpretive evidence, not a numeric stop-buffer definition.

supplement_policy: Reuse existing recent files for the same eligible universe, subject to exact overlapping OHLCV agreement and continuity checks before merging. Preserve gaps and per-symbol coverage; no downloads or source substitution. WIFUSDT September16 example is absent from the old229-symbol tail but present here.
example_data_read: WIFUSDT.csv.gz physically read:89904rows,2025-11-15T00:00:00Z through2026-09-23T03:55:00Z; gaps and cross-source overlaps still need full preflight before signal generation

groups.second: Existing eligible Binance perpetual altcoin universe, excluding BTC/ETH, stablecoins, gold proxies and classified traditional/index assets

weekly_levels: Completed Monday H/L; lower=L-0.618*(H-L), upper=H+0.618*(H-L); freeze the trigger week's anchors
first_touch: First observed post-Monday directional touch per NY week; crypto requires an uninterrupted weekly prefix

implementation_interpretations_to_finali.ma_confirmation: Proposed: close above the contemporaneous completed-bar six-MA maximum for long, then three subsequent closes remaining above; mirror short
implementation_interpretations_to_finali.entry_line: Proposed: resting limit at the latest completed-bar MA envelope; any repricing becomes effective only afterward, never within the candle that computed the MA
implementation_interpretations_to_finali.stop_freeze: Freeze the owner-defined stop when the associated entry order is submitted; if an unfilled entry is repriced, update its unfilled stop specification causally
implementation_interpretations_to_finali.range_invalidation: Before entry only; exact wick-versus-close observation and ordering must be recorded before replay
implementation_interpretations_to_finali.monitor_expiry: Must explicitly define the anchor transition; do not inherit an unrelated 12h/20h timer
implementation_interpretations_to_finali.position_expiry: No new holding timer is authorized; data boundaries/gaps remain censored

execution_status: Existing resting-limit entry and target support verified. Dynamic pre-fill repricing and invalidation still need causal adapter integration and regression checks; no historical positions executed.
parameter_search: No new grid authorized; any subsequent parameter research must use VectorBT with explicit ranges
fee_basis: Current owner-recorded OKX Lv1 scenario on Binance candles; resting limit entry/TP maker, market and protective-stop fills taker; actual per-fill notionals
gold: Existing HistData M1 ZIPs, corrected source NY clock and conflict-exclusion adapter; bid-only gross results, unknown spread/broker fees; no fabricated volume
control_protocol: Match symbol, NY week, side and causal volatility bucket; explicitly align pending-entry opportunity and execution semantics before replay. Do not call unmatched fills a matched-control result.
